messages.author: a22e8a7b2a35fc51
messages.subject: rstan 2.12.1 "hash mismatch so recompiling" message
parts:
Hi,

I've recently upgrade R to 3.3.2 and installed rstan version 2.12.1.

I had a previous rstan (2.9.x?) working on R 3.2.x.

I have modified Makevars to ignore the compiler warnings  (not seen with my previous version) as per the warnings page and edited my code to replace <- with = assignments.

When compiling the code in R with

stan_mod <- stan_model('code.stan')

I get the message:
hash mismatch so recompiling; make sure Stan code ends with a blank line

I don't recall seeing this before. I went back and added a blank line to my code but the message still appears.

I'm assuming I've got something not set up quite right.

Any suggestions? I'm on MacOSX 10.11.6

My Makevars looks like this:

# created by rstan at Tue Jun  9 16:27:23 2015
# Added after upgrade to rstan 2.12.1 to avoid warnings: -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-local-typedefs
CXXFLAGS = -Wall -mtune=core2 -O3 $(LTO) -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-local-typedefs #set_by_rstan
R_XTRA_CPPFLAGS =  -I$(R_INCLUDE_DIR)   #set_by_rstan
CC=clang
CXX=clang++ -arch x86_64 -ftemplate-depth-256

Thanks,
Ron.

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: rstan 2.12.1 "hash mismatch so recompiling" message
parts:
On Friday, November 18, 2016 at 8:50:26 AM UTC-5, Ron wrote:
I have modified Makevars to ignore the compiler warnings  (not seen with my previous version) as per the warnings page and edited my code to replace <- with = assignments.

When compiling the code in R with

stan_mod <- stan_model('code.stan')

I get the message:
hash mismatch so recompiling; make sure Stan code ends with a blank line

I don't recall seeing this before. I went back and added a blank line to my code but the message still appears.

If your code.rda file was originally derived from a code.stan file with <- as the assignment indicator and now it uses =, then there will be a hash mismatch. You just need to force a new code.rda file to be created once, by doing rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE) beforehand.

Ben
